find-docs.description: Retrieves up-to-date documentation, API references, and code examples for any library or framework via Context7 CLI (ctx7)

find-skills.description: Discover and install agent skills from community registries via npx skills CLI

frontend-design.description: Creates distinctive, production-quality frontend interfaces (Angular/HTML/CSS components, pages, dashboards); avoids generic AI aesthetics

caveman.description: Ultra-compressed output mode (~75% fewer tokens). Makes agent talk like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan.
caveman.securityAssessment: Safe · JS utility skill · read-only output transformation

backprop.description: Bug → spec protocol. When tests fail or bugs surface, traces root cause, adds §B entry to spec, promotes recurring patterns to §V invariants in CHECKPOINTS.md. Closes the fix-and-forget gap.
backprop.securityAssessment: Safe · pure spec-editing protocol · no external calls

sp-writing-plans.description: Generates a detailed implementation plan (TDD, bite-sized tasks, file structure, interfaces) from an approved spec. Saved to docs/superpowers/plans/. Invoke between an approved spec_ready and launching implementer.
sp-writing-plans.securityAssessment: Safe · planning skill · no external calls

sp-subagent.description: Subagent-driven development: dispatches one implementer subagent per independent task, review after each one, final review of the branch. Use for features with ≥3 independent tasks.
sp-subagent.securityAssessment: Safe · orchestration skill · no external calls

sp-verify.description: Verification before declaring completeness. Requires fresh evidence (./verify.ps1 output) before issuing APPROVED or any success claim. Evidence before assertions.
sp-verify.securityAssessment: Safe · verification skill · no external calls

graphify.description: Convierte el codebase en un knowledge graph consultable (tree-sitter + GraphRAG). Genera graph.html (visual), GRAPH_REPORT.md (resumen) y graph.json (queryable). Callflow Mermaid con 'graphify export callflow-html'. Instalar con: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install --project
graphify.securityAssessment: Safe · 68k stars · YC S26 · local-only graph generation
graphify.installNote: PyPI package is 'graphifyy' (double-y). CLI command remains 'graphify'. Run: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install --project && graphify .

genova-dev.description: GenOVA master dev workflow: sizes the task, activates plan mode for large work, generates a plan-ledger .md with subtasks and an assigned model (haiku/sonnet/opus), dispatches subagents with their own memory, and applies the project's commit rules (no Co-Authored-By)
genova-dev.securityAssessment: Safe · skill de orquestación local · sin llamadas externas

genova-angular.description: GenOVA's own Angular frontend conventions: screaming architecture (features/<domain> vs core/), standalone+OnPush+zoneless+inject(), Signal Forms, SpartanUI (libs/ui + gn-* wrappers) and quality gates (250 lines, strict ESLint, responsive). Complements the official angular-developer skill
genova-angular.securityAssessment: Safe · local code conventions · no external calls

genova-fastapi.description: GenOVA's own FastAPI backend conventions: router.py->service.py->models.py per domain, hard security (commit_or_500, @limiter.limit, never log secrets), ruff/200-line limit, migrations and ORM cascades (checkpoint C14)
genova-fastapi.securityAssessment: Safe · local code conventions · no external calls

genova-audit.description: Full, harsh audit of the GenOVA repo against CHECKPOINTS.md (C1-C14), screaming architecture, dead code, and security, with a thermo-nuclear-style 'code judo' lens. Produces a severity-ranked report with file:line in sdd/audits/. Manual invocation (disable-model-invocation)
genova-audit.securityAssessment: Safe · read-only audit + reporting skill · no external calls
genova-audit.installNote: Manual invocation only (/genova-audit) - does not auto-trigger from conversation triggers.
